universe_source: Wikipedia S&P 500 list + disclosed selected growth/ETF symbols
score_explanation: Price score screens the full universe. The research shortlist scores verified fundamentals (30), valuation (25), selloff (20), and financial strength (15). Catalysts (10) require manual research and are not awarded automatically.

research_method.fundamental_source: Yahoo Finance data accessed through yfinance; fields may be delayed or unavailable.
research_method.filing_source: SEC EDGAR company filings, linked by CIK when available.

research.catalyst_status: Manual research required; no automated catalyst points awarded.
